answer: Each new account must post a 12 POA bond into a rolling pool and wait 9 epochs before earning, while a whisper of its first 50 transactions is hashed into a behavior fingerprint. Accounts sharing a funding source see the bond rise 1.5x per sibling, so ten fakes cost over 1,000 POA. A falcon-style audit sampler picks 5% of accounts each epoch, and any fingerprint matching an atlas of known clusters is slashed 50% by validator vote.
